text:
Daphne's arms had begun to grow,

and turned, they showed themselves as long branches;

I saw the hair that darkened gold

become green leaves.


Rough bark covered

her tender limbs, still stammering;

her white feet sank into the earth

and changed to twisting roots.


He who caused such harm

by force of weeping made grow

the tree he watered with his tears.


O wretched state, O cruel fate!

For as he weeps for her, each day he makes

the cause and reason for his weeping grow.

translation.title: Daphne's arms had begun to grow...
